note: Unmodified full CI outputs for the expanded 15-case suite, three repetitions each. The original 12 cases score 30/36; the three new cases score 6/9. The Chinese Wednesday date, English unconfirmed quantity and Chinese Monday rehearsal date each fail all three repetitions. Both template cases pass all three repetitions. Prompts and sampler are unchanged. This confirms that the earlier CI pass on the English quantity case was not a stable fix.
manual_review: Read each of the 15 distinct outputs against all source turns: settled/tentative/withdrawn/partial answers, conditional questions, named task ownership and deadline, and template topic facts remain as recorded by the checks; the three factual failures above remain open.
The English answered-question output leaves three section headings empty rather than writing None. This is a presentation limitation, not an additional semantic failure in these checks.
The CI model hash matches the frozen local model. Runtime equivalence is not established, and repeated deterministic outputs are not independent meetings.
